components.name: Android application and acquisition service
components.purpose: Own permissions, the user-started location foreground service, SensorManager/LocationManager callbacks, capabilities and live/replay source selection.
components.responsibilities: Preserve native samples; tag provider and clocks; expose lifecycle/context; never estimate or rewrite evidence.
components.inputs: Android callbacks; replay source; user commands
components.failure_behaviour: Fail closed on missing mandatory accelerometer/gyro or permission; publish capability status
components.required_tests: JVM; instrumentation; physical-device S1
components.current_evidence_status: S1 implementation verified; physical protocol incomplete

components.name: Session evidence writer
components.purpose: Persist immutable, replayable source evidence and manifests.
components.responsibilities: Append JSONL chunks; sequence, hash, fsync, rotate, recover partial sessions, export ZIP.
components.failure_behaviour: Mark INCOMPLETE or EVIDENCE_DEGRADED; never invent missing records
components.required_tests: Writer unit; crash recovery; low-storage; replay round-trip
components.current_evidence_status: S1 writer path verified synthetically; device durability pending

components.name: Timebase and sensor-quality adapter
components.purpose: Validate ordering/rates without destroying source timing or axes.
components.responsibilities: Compute dt/age; retain arrival time; detect gaps, batching, non-monotonicity, saturation and missing streams; form bounded batches.
components.owned_state: Per-stream last sequence/timestamp and health windows
components.failure_behaviour: Reject invalid core input while recording the raw event and typed reason
components.required_tests: Property; fixtures; S1 replay
components.current_evidence_status: S1 contract verified; delivered rates device-specific

components.name: Calibration manager
components.purpose: Supply bias/noise priors and stationary evidence; never own the operational bias.
components.responsibilities: Stationary detection, profile selection, prior covariance and validity.
components.failure_behaviour: Emit invalid/unavailable prior; core uses conservative initialization
components.required_tests: Synthetic stationary; replay; prior/core ownership invariant
components.current_evidence_status: Method not physically validated; S2 boundary frozen

components.name: Alignment and mount-state estimator
components.purpose: Own phone-body to vehicle rotation posterior and mount-change state outside S2.
components.responsibilities: Estimate alignment with covariance; gate observability; detect change; expose VALID/UNCERTAIN/SLIP_SUSPECTED.
components.failure_behaviour: Disable alignment-dependent learned/kinematic constraints; never fabricate yaw
components.required_tests: S3 controlled orientation/slip protocol; replay; absent magnetometer
components.current_evidence_status: S3 unresolved mandatory gate

components.name: Navigation-core JNI adapter
components.purpose: Batch canonical measurements into the C++ core without Android types or per-sample serialization.
components.responsibilities: Validate ABI/schema; copy/direct-buffer ownership; serialize calls on one executor; translate typed results.
components.owned_state: Core handle and ABI version only
components.failure_behaviour: Stop scientific output and publish CORE_FAULT; never restart as continuous state
components.required_tests: JNI contract; lifecycle; malformed buffer; parity fixtures
components.current_evidence_status: Boundary selected; integration not executed

components.name: Canonical C++ navigation core
components.purpose: Sole owner of S2 nominal state, operational biases, covariance, evidence-ID ledger, propagation and GNSS updates.
components.responsibilities: S2 midpoint propagation; ESKF covariance; innovation gates; Joseph update; reset Jacobian; numerical checks.
components.failure_behaviour: Reject invalid dt/evidence; surface numeric fault; no state repair that hides defects
components.required_tests: S2 unit; finite difference; C++/NumPy parity; fuzz/property
components.current_evidence_status: S2 bounded mathematical behaviour accepted; real-phone drift unproved

components.name: Learned-correction adapter
components.purpose: Run an optional bounded model and decide whether its proposal is eligible.
components.responsibilities: Window/mask/normalize; deadline; OOD/range checks; shadow mode; provenance; never mutate raw evidence.
components.owned_state: Window buffer, runtime/model identity and counters
components.failure_behaviour: Reject/timeout and continue classical baseline
components.required_tests: Golden tensors; timeout/OOD; disabled-model baseline; export parity
components.current_evidence_status: S4 unexecuted; IO-VNBD private experiment permitted conditionally

components.name: GNSS integrity and reacquisition controller
components.purpose: Convert one provenance-preserving location family into canonical gated updates and controlled return.
components.responsibilities: Quality state; covariance floors; outage hysteresis; consume evidence once; dwell/consistency on return.
components.failure_behaviour: Reject inconsistent/stale fixes; remain DR/degraded; never privilege first return
components.required_tests: Biased/intermittent return; duplicate ID; stale fix; state-machine fixtures
components.current_evidence_status: S2 single-update gate accepted; thresholds provisional

components.name: Road-graph store and top-K matcher
components.purpose: Generate bounded directed-road hypotheses without overwriting navigation state.
components.responsibilities: Verify graph manifest; spatial candidates; topology/direction/covariance scores; top-K; ambiguity and abstention.
components.owned_state: Verified map version and previous same-version hypotheses
components.failure_behaviour: MISSING_MAP/NO_CANDIDATE/AMBIGUOUS; publish unmatched navigation
components.required_tests: S6 fixtures; determinism; version mismatch; false-clear negatives
components.current_evidence_status: S6B1 deterministic graph and two route candidates accepted conditionally; runtime matcher unbuilt

components.name: Navigation-state repository and output publisher
components.purpose: Publish immutable scientific snapshots and separately derived display snapshots.
components.responsibilities: Approximately 10 Hz output pacing; monotonic revision; no feedback from display smoothing; expose modes/provenance.
components.failure_behaviour: Hold last display only with STALE marker; scientific output invalid/stopped is explicit
components.required_tests: Rate; separation; stale/fault; process recreation
components.current_evidence_status: Contract selected; integrated rate pending

components.name: Replay provider and demo scenario controller
components.purpose: Provide deterministic recorded input and software-only GNSS visibility control through live-compatible contracts.
components.responsibilities: Replay ordering; speed/pause/seek restrictions; scenario masks; labels LIVE/REPLAY/SIMULATED_OUTAGE/DEMO.
components.failure_behaviour: Reject corrupt/incomplete sessions unless explicitly diagnostic; no silent repair
components.required_tests: Determinism; corrupted manifest; mask isolation; live/replay contract
components.current_evidence_status: Architecture decision accepted; implementation pending

components.name: Offline map and navigation UI
components.purpose: Render local map, routes, scientific/reference traces, candidates, uncertainty and honest mode labels.
components.responsibilities: MapLibre local PMTiles; attribution; UI state adaptation; after-run comparison; accessibility.
components.failure_behaviour: Show map unavailable and retain textual scientific state; never fake movement
components.required_tests: Screenshot/accessibility; airplane mode; attribution; device renderer
components.current_evidence_status: S6A foundation conditional; Android renderer not validated

components.name: Offline analyzer and evaluation harness
components.purpose: Reproduce sessions and compute drift, latency, rate, integrity, map and resource metrics.
components.responsibilities: Immutable input verification; endpoint/max/RMSE metrics; unmatched/matched/display separation; reports.
components.outputs: Versioned evaluation reports and experiment manifests
components.failure_behaviour: No metric on failed provenance/ground-truth checks
components.required_tests: Golden metrics; independent recomputation; malformed inputs
components.current_evidence_status: S1 analyzer pattern verified; full integrated analyzer pending

components.name: IO-VNBD ingestion and feature firewall
components.purpose: Privately ingest allowed IO-VNBD bytes, validate schemas/dedup/splits and prevent vehicle-label leakage.
components.responsibilities: Pinned manifests; six-schema allowlist; parent-session split; runtime-feature audit; no raw public artifacts.
components.failure_behaviour: Quarantine unknown schema/hash/unit; stop experiment
components.required_tests: Schema/dedup/leakage/canary/future-GNSS tests
components.current_evidence_status: S0 audit complete; status overridden to organizer-directed conditional private use

components.name: Training and evaluation pipeline
components.purpose: Train/ablate optional learned aids with journey-safe splits and frozen scenarios.
components.responsibilities: Baselines; grouped splits; model/normalization provenance; evaluation; export candidate.
components.failure_behaviour: No export when leakage, rights, split or metric checks fail
components.required_tests: Determinism; split isolation; baselines; ablations
components.current_evidence_status: Experiment permitted conditionally; no performance executed

components.name: Model packaging validator
components.purpose: Prove exported model/runtime/normalization compatibility before Android inclusion.
components.responsibilities: Hash model; schema/opset/runtime version; golden-vector parity; size/latency budget; redistribution flag.
components.failure_behaviour: Reject bundle; app runs model-disabled
components.required_tests: Golden tensors; corrupt manifest; unsupported op; timeout
components.current_evidence_status: Unexecuted S4

components.name: Map and graph build tooling
components.purpose: Rebuild display/graph artifacts from one frozen lawful PBF with lineage.
components.responsibilities: Hash source; build PMTiles/SQLite; stable IDs; notices; fixtures and candidate routes.
components.failure_behaviour: Abort on hash/tool/lineage mismatch
components.required_tests: S6 deterministic build; graph schema/topology
components.current_evidence_status: S6B1 graph built: 19/19 tests; PMTiles/device path pending

components.name: Artifact and manifest validator
components.purpose: Validate all distributable artifacts, notices, hashes, schemas and forbidden content.
components.responsibilities: JSON/CSV/schema parsing; manifest hashes; clean extraction; secrets/private/raw-data checks.
components.failure_behaviour: Block merge/release
components.required_tests: Self-test fixtures; tamper detection
components.current_evidence_status: Pattern proven by S6 manifests; repo implementation pending

components.name: Contracts and configuration package
components.purpose: Version schemas, enums, units, frames, clock domains, validation and feature flags.
components.responsibilities: JSON Schema/Proto definitions; generated bindings; compatibility tests; configuration identity.
components.failure_behaviour: Unknown major version rejected; incompatible change requires ADR
components.required_tests: Schema compatibility; codegen determinism; round-trip
components.current_evidence_status: Conceptual contracts frozen by this baseline; implementation pending
